groups.label: Rising vs Falling Intonation
groups.definition: Pitch movements conveying grammatical sentence type, certainty, or check-in politeness.
rules: Rising intonation ↗: Yes/No questions and polite check-ins (Are you ready? ↗).
Falling intonation ↘: Statements, Wh- questions, and firm commands (Where do you live? ↘).
